critique: The snowfall now fills the entire frame rather than the narrow central column seen previously, and it has a convincing mix of fine specks and larger softly blurred flakes. Downward movement is apparent between t1 and t4. However, the field still builds noticeably in density from t1 to t4 instead of maintaining a settled, continuous snowfall state. The background reads essentially pure black, which is harsher and flatter than a deep blue snowy-night backdrop.

suggestions.why: Shortening particle life lets the simulation reach its steady visible density sooner, reducing the sparse-start versus crowded-later difference between t1 and t4.
Compensate for the reduced lifetime so the settled snowfall remains richly populated rather than becoming too sparse.
Lift the backdrop from near-black to a restrained blue-black night sky, preserving white snow contrast while better matching a snowy-night presentation.
